blurb: From the 1950’s to the 1970’s Forks was the self-proclaimed “Logging Capital of the World”, and the Forks Timber Museum was established in 1984 to preserve and document this rich logging history, plus the pioneer history of early homesteaders in the Olympic Peninsula wilderness.
